newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to seek approval for share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to seek approval for share buyback.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico said Thursday it will seek stockholder approval at its Dec. 10 annual meeting to start a new programme to repurchase up to an additional 800 million of its shares.

"From December 5, 1995, when Telmex decided to rebuy 1 billion shares, the company has repurchased about 790 million of them up until today," Gerardo Munoz, director of investor relations with the telephone company, told Reuters.
"This new proposal looks to authorise an additional programme of 800 million more and for the corresponding reserves to be made," he said.
The buyback, which will be done with company funds, does not involve Telmex's American Depositary Receipts shares, which rose 25 cents to $32 on the New York Stock Exchange Thursday.
